result.description: Devin is Cognition's autonomous AI software engineer. It takes tasks as sessions, writes and runs code, and opens PRs.
result.auth_detail: Bearer tokens with a cog_ prefix. Service user API key (org or enterprise scope, RBAC role, expiring) for automation. Personal Access Token for acting as a human user. Legacy apk_ keys are deprecated. No OAuth2 for third-party apps was found.
result.access_detail: Keys are self-serve. An admin provisions a service user under Settings > Devin API in a Devin org, or creates a PAT, and copies the cog_ key. This needs a Devin account and org, and Devin is a paid product. I could not confirm the free or trial terms from the pricing page. Enterprise endpoints (analytics, audit logs, billing) are enterprise-only. Each customer must create their own key, so there is no OAuth app flow.
result.api_notes: REST v3 at api.devin.ai/v3/organizations/* and /v3/enterprise/*. The organization scope covers sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets, schedules and users. The enterprise scope covers analytics, audit logs, user management, billing and service-user keys. I did not count the endpoints.
result.blocker: No OAuth for third parties. Users must paste a cog_ key from a paid Devin org, and enterprise-scope keys also need an X-Org-Id header. I could not confirm the plan gating.

evidence.quote: All API credentials use the `cog_` prefix format. Include your token in the `Authorization` header of every request:
A **Personal Access Token** authenticates as the **human user** who created it — that user's identity, permissions, and org memberships apply.
Go to **Settings > Devin API** in your organization and open the **Service users** tab
For managing resources within a single organization — sessions, knowledge, playbooks, secrets, and more.
For cross-organization management — analytics, audit logs, user management, billing, and infrastructure. Available to enterprise customers.
The Devin MCP server is an authenticated service that provides access to both public and private repositories, plus full platform management capabilities.
